title: CRIC Agent Commons Architecture
summary: Technical architecture for reusable CRIC agents: package structure, factory API, manifest and output schemas, toolsets, permissions, risk classes, provenance and versioning rules.
notes: Path sits under docs/CRIC-PRD-v0.1/ (PRD-family signal) but content signals are dominantly SPEC: package layout, factory function signature, agent.yaml manifest field schema, required/optional dataset schema, typed output classes, permission capability list, versioning rules, testing contracts. No user stories or acceptance criteria; the 'v0.1 Deliverables' list is the only requirement-shaped section. Ambiguity resolved toward SPEC (higher precedence than PRD). Referenced by name only, no links: Constitutional Product Rule #13, Responsible Autonomy review levels 2/3, candidate traceability requirement 'R-041' (explicitly not assumed by this doc) — none recorded as cross_refs since no doc paths appear. Filename suffix is the source directory path rather than a SHA-256 prefix: no Bash tool available to compute the hash; the suffix is still deterministic and collision-free per source path.
